name: @acidicts/granite-md
description: Granite MD — a self-hosted markdown knowledge base built with Rails.

scripts.test: i=${SHARD_INDEX:-1}; n=${SHARD_TOTAL:-1}; specs=$(find spec -name '*_spec.rb' | sort | awk -v i="$i" -v n="$n" 'NR % n == (i - 1) % n { print }'); count=$(printf '%s\n' "$specs" | grep -c . || true); if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then echo "rspec shard $i/$n: no spec files assigned"; else echo "rspec shard $i/$n: running $count spec files"; bundle exec rspec --tag '~skip' $specs; fi
